questions.q: What does a C++ compiler do, as distinct from a linker?
options: It combines multiple object files into one executable
It translates a single .cpp source file into an object file of machine code
It decides which files need to be recompiled
It runs the final program
questions.explain: A compiler works on one translation unit (one .cpp file) at a time, producing an object file. Combining object files into an executable is the linker's job.

questions.q: Put the four compilation stages in the correct order.
options: Linking, Assembly, Compilation, Preprocessing
Preprocessing, Compilation, Assembly, Linking
Compilation, Preprocessing, Linking, Assembly
Assembly, Linking, Preprocessing, Compilation
questions.explain: A source file is first preprocessed (#include/#define expanded), then compiled to assembly, then assembled into an object file, then linked into an executable.

questions.q: In the command `g++ -std=c++20 -O2 -Wall -Wextra hello.cpp -o hello`, what does `-Wall -Wextra` do?
options: Selects the C++ language standard
Names the output file
Enables optimization
Turns on extra compiler warnings to help catch bugs
questions.explain: -Wall and -Wextra enable additional compiler warnings; -std=c++20 selects the standard, -O2 enables optimization, and -o names the output.

questions.q: Why do real multi-file C++ projects use a build system like CMake instead of typing g++ commands by hand?
options: g++ cannot compile more than one file at all
CMake removes the need for a compiler entirely
A build system tracks which files changed and only recompiles what's necessary, across platforms
Build systems make the resulting program run faster at runtime
questions.explain: CMake generates platform-specific build files and, together with the underlying build tool, recompiles only files that changed — something that doesn't scale when typing compiler commands by hand.

questions.q: What is a 'translation unit' in C++?
options: A single preprocessed .cpp file, as the compiler sees it when compiling
A compiled executable
A function that translates data types
A CMake configuration file
questions.explain: A translation unit is one .cpp file after preprocessing — the unit of work the compiler processes at a time, independent of other files.
